review_evidence: README describes a Lean 4 Verso genre for reveal.js presentations, and the unit contains 41 Lean files implementing configuration, rendering, elaboration, fragmenting, theming, and embedded-code support.
Demo.lean contains formal examples including replicate_length, fact_pos, and sum_to_formula; fixture/test trees also exercise typed slide/document interfaces rather than being generated artifacts.
No source-local subtree can be removed solely as tests/demo without discarding independently searchable formal declarations or interface behavior.
summary: Retain VersoSlides implementation, demo, fixtures, and tests because examples and validation sources contain substantive Lean definitions and theorem statements alongside the slide-rendering interfaces.
